entries.addVersion: Add a version in another language

redirects.targetHelp: https://… address to send visitors to.
redirects.orEntryHelp: The shortcut will always follow this entry's current link, even if it changes.
redirects.error.reserved: This path is reserved or used by a collection.
redirects.error.exists: This path already has a redirect.
home.intro: The home page has no content of its own: it is an assembly of sections offered by your module instances. Pick, order and configure them.
navigation.intro: Build your site menu here: your pages and links, in the order you want. Features with their own menu entry (blog, partners…) show automatically first.
navigation.hrefHelp: A page of your site (/contact) or a full address (https://…)
navigation.label: Label
navigation.error.label: Give each link a label in at least one language.
settings.languagesHelp: The main language uses the plain address; the others open under /en, /fr… Nothing forces you to translate everything.
settings.adminLocaleHelp: Each user can override it in their account.
settings.autoDetect: Detect the visitor's language on first visit
settings.autoDetectHelp: Based on the browser language, only on the home page.
settings.appearanceHelp: Text and surface colors are derived automatically so they stay readable.
modules.intro: Everything on the site is a module: blogs, social links, promo codes, pages, the home banner, RSS, the contact form… Each module can have several instances — two blogs, two lists of social links (one per channel) — each with its own settings, content, address and admin entry.
modules.broken: This module cannot be loaded (see server logs).
modules.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall this module and delete its data and settings?
modules.install: Install a module from a git repository
modules.warning: A module is code that runs on your server with full access to your site. Only install modules from authors you trust, and read the code first. A module is installed disabled; nothing runs until you enable it.
modules.repoHelp: https://host/owner/repo — add #tag or #branch to pin a version.
modules.disabledNotice: This module is disabled: its instances do not appear on the site. Enable it from the modules list.
modules.error.host: This host is not allowed (see MODULES_ALLOWED_HOSTS).
modules.error.clone: The repository could not be downloaded.
modules.error.nomanifest: No valid module.json at the root of the repository.
modules.error.nomain: The file declared in "main" does not exist.
modules.error.exists: A module with this id is already installed.
modules.error.load: The module could not be loaded.
users.exists: A user with this email already exists.
account.languageHelp: Language of this admin, just for you.
site.fallbackNotice: This content is not available in your language yet — shown in {lang}.
setup.title: Set up your site
setup.language.title: Languages
setup.language.default: What language will your site be in?
setup.language.defaultHelp: Also used for the admin by default. You can change everything later.
setup.language.extraHelp: Nothing is forced: you decide, entry by entry, whether to translate.
setup.identity.title: Nice to meet you, {name}! What's your site called?
setup.identity.name: Your site's name
setup.links.title: Where else can people find you?
setup.links.help: Add your networks (Twitch, YouTube…). Each can also get a short address, like /twitch.
setup.links.label: Name (e.g. Twitch)
setup.links.iconHelp: Icon: the platform's name (twitch, youtube, instagram, tiktok, discord…) or an emoji.
setup.account.title: Last step, {name}: your access
setup.account.name: Your name
setup.account.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A sentence you'll remember is perfect.
setup.account.tokenHelp: The code you were given with your server: it stops a stranger from claiming a brand-new site.
setup.error.password: The password needs at least 10 characters.
instances.add: Add an instance (new blog, new list…)
instances.basePathHelp: /blog → https://site/blog. Empty = at the site root (/my-page).
instances.customFieldsHelp: One per line: key | label | type (text, url, number, boolean).
instances.fallback: Fall back to the default language
instances.fallbackHelp: Show the default-language version when an entry is not translated.
instances.goLinksHelp: Short redirect to the entry's link.
instances.deleteWarning: Deleting an instance also deletes its entries, settings and stored data.
instances.error.path: The URL segment may only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
instances.error.pathUsed: Another instance already uses this URL segment.
instances.error.redirectClash: A redirect already uses this path.
instances.error.name: The name in the default language is required.
instances.error.single: This module allows a single instance.
home.optionsHint: After saving, the options of each section (for example how many entries) appear on its row.
social.title: Social networks
social.intro: Add your networks: each becomes a button in the site header. You can add several of the same network (one channel for you, another for a friend).
social.toSet: To set up: enter your profile address.
social.headerHint: The buttons appear in the site header ({page}, Appearance tab, to hide them).
social.noneAvailable: No network available in the Catalogue yet.
social.ownerOnly: Only the site owner can add a network.
settings.layersHelp: Four layers stack from the lowest (1) to the highest (4). Only the colour is required: the glow, the image and the pattern are optional and combine freely.
settings.layer.colorNote: Always there: it is the colour chosen above. It stays visible wherever nothing covers it.
settings.layer.glowNote: Large soft patches drawn from your accent colour. Best on a dark background.
settings.layer.imageNote: Optional. It sits on top of the colour and the glow; with no image, nothing changes.
settings.layer.patternNote: A decoration on top of everything else (grid, dusk…), drawn from your colours.
field.tagsHelp: Comma-separated. Other modules (overlays…) can filter entries by tag.
instances.exposed: Offer its entries to other modules
instances.exposedHelp: Overlays and other modules can use this instance's published entries (topic core.entry). They only see what is public.
sources.title: Where the information comes from
sources.intro: This module shows information offered by other modules. Choose which ones feed it.
sources.none: No instance offers this kind of information yet.
sources.tags: Only entries with one of these tags
mode.help: Simple mode shows what most people need. Advanced mode adds technical settings (URLs, fields, sources, installation from git…). Nothing you set in one mode is lost in the other.
dashboard.introAdvanced: Where your site stands: what needs your attention, visits and key numbers.
dashboard.visitsEmpty: No visit yet: as soon as someone opens your site, it will show up here.
users.intro: The people who can sign in to this admin area, and what each of them can do here.
users.rolesHelp: Owner: everything, including backups and updates. Administrator: manages the site, features and the editors. Editor: writes and publishes content.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}'s account? They will no longer be able to sign in. Their content stays on the site.
users.addHelp: They sign in with their email and the password you choose here; they can change it in “My account”.
updates.intro: Keep your site up to date: see where you stand, what the new version changes, then install it in one click.
updates.noNotes: No release notes are available for this one.
updates.happens.backup: A safety copy of your site is made first.
updates.happens.rollback: If anything fails, the previous version is restored on its own.
updates.runningHelp: The site stays usable until the restart. This page refreshes by itself.
updates.dontClose: You can leave this page: the update carries on without you. The site will be unavailable for a moment while it restarts.
updates.step.between: Moving on to the next version
updates.step.rollback: Going back to the previous version
updates.failure.checksum-mismatch: The downloaded file does not match the published one: it was refused as a precaution.
updates.failure.bad-archive: The downloaded file is damaged or incomplete.
updates.failure.plan-failed: The update path could not be prepared (the versions repository may be unreachable).
updates.failure.step: One step of the installation failed.
updates.partialHelp: {n} more version(s) remain to be installed. Restart the server, then click “Install” again: it picks up where it stopped.
updates.partialShort: {version} is installed, the rest is still to do.
account.intro: Your details, how you sign in, and the devices where you are signed in.
account.passwordHelp: Your password, to sign in. Pick one you use nowhere else.
account.securityHelp: A password can be guessed or stolen. These two protections add a second door: turn on one or the other, or both.
account.sessionsZone: If a device was lost or lent
audit.noResultHelp: Try another word: an email address, or a word like “login” or “backup”.
audit.action.login.recovery: Signed in with a backup code
audit.action.login.locked: Sign-in blocked after too many attempts
audit.action.security.2fa.require: Two-step verification required for the whole team
audit.action.mcp.grants.defaults: A token's actions reset to defaults
audit.action.mcp.grants.none: All of a token's actions removed
mcp.disableConfirm: Turn MCP off? No assistant will be able to use your site, even with a token. Your tokens are kept.
mcp.tokensHelp: A token is an assistant's password: give each assistant its own, so you can remove one without touching the others. Click a token to choose what it is allowed to do.
mcp.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token “{name}”? The assistant using it loses access immediately. This cannot be undone.
mcp.newTokenHelp: Name it after the assistant that will use it.
mcp.afterCreate: The token is shown only once, right after it is created: copy it. Then click its name to choose what it can do (step 3).
mode.page.title: Simple or advanced
mode.page.safe: This choice only affects you: the rest of the team keeps theirs.
mode.page.simple.title: Simple mode
mode.page.simple.for: The essentials, in everyday words. Recommended for writing, customising and running the site.
mode.page.simple.1: Features you turn on or off in one click
mode.page.advanced.title: Advanced mode
mode.page.advanced.for: Every setting, for those who want full control.
mode.page.advanced.1: Addresses, sources, versions and technical identifiers
mode.page.advanced.2: Audit log and AI assistant access (API & MCP)
mode.page.advanced.3: Installing from personal sources, early-versions channel
modules.emptyHelp: A blog, a contact form, a stream overlay… Every feature is added in one click from the catalogue.
modules.uninstallHelp: Removes this feature from the site, with its settings and data. Make a backup first if you are not sure.
editor.heading: Heading
redirects.introSimple: A shortcut is a short address on your site that sends visitors somewhere else. For example, "{site}/twitch" can lead to your Twitch channel: easy to say out loud, to put in a bio or under a video, and if your link ever changes you only update it here.
modules.introSimple: This is what your site does. Switch each feature on or off, and adjust it in one click.
dashboard.shortcutsHelp: Short addresses like /twitch that lead to your links.
dashboard.addFeatureHelp: A second blog, a contact form, an overlay for your stream…
dashboard.viewSiteHelp: Open it the way visitors see it.
mcp.title: API & MCP
mcp.intro: Connect an AI assistant (Claude, for example) to your site so it can read your content or write drafts. It can reach nothing without a token, and each token only opens what you allow.
mcp.off: MCP is disabled — nobody can use it, tokens included.
mcp.safety: Safety rules that cannot be changed: a read-only token never writes; irreversible actions are never on by default; every write is recorded in the audit log; the content editor only lets an assistant create or edit drafts.
mcp.scopeHelp: The ceiling of the token. “Read & write” allows write actions to be granted; you still choose them one by one afterwards.
mcp.noTokens: Create a first token below to connect an assistant.
mcp.tokenCreated: Copy this token now, it will not be shown again:
mcp.toolsHelp: Collected from every active module. Modules and instances can opt out (advanced settings of the instance).
instances.mcp: Offer its actions to the MCP API
instances.mcpHelp: Assistants connected through MCP can use this instance's actions (drafts, internal files…).
mcp.accessIntro: Choose, action by action, what this token may do. Changes apply immediately — no need to create a new token. Each module decides which of its actions are on by default; the others stay off until you turn them on here.
mcp.readCeiling: This is a read-only token: actions that write stay locked, whatever is checked. Create a read & write token to allow them.
mcp.resetAll: Reset every action of this token to the module defaults
mcp.instanceOptedOut: This instance has withdrawn its actions from MCP (advanced settings of the instance): nothing here can be used.
mcp.confirmDestructive: “{action}” is irreversible (it deletes data). Allow this token to do it?
settings.aboutHelp: Markdown. Shown wherever the site presents itself, for example in a press kit.
brand.role.accentFg: Text placed on the accent color
instances.nicknameAdminHelp: Tells your {module} instances apart in the admin (not shown on the site). The site's own name for it is set below.
instances.nicknameHelp: Short and recognizable: it is how you will find it in the menus. Only used to tell them apart.
instances.error.nickname.empty: Give a nickname so you can tell them apart.
instances.error.nickname.long: This nickname is too long (40 characters maximum).
instances.error.nickname.taken: Another one already has this nickname.
settings.mailHelp: The server that sends your site's e-mails. Your features use it to notify you; they never get to see the password.
settings.mailPassHelp: Leave empty to keep the current one. It is never shown again.
settings.mailTest: Send a test email to my address
settings.mailStatusOff: No e-mail server yet: the site cannot send messages.
settings.mailTestFail: Sending failed. Check the server, port and password.
settings.mailTestBody: If you can read this, sending email works.
audit.action.settings.rawg.import: RAWG key taken over from a module
settings.servicesHelp: Online services your features can use. You set them up once here; features never see their keys.
settings.rawgHelp: RAWG provides game images. Create a free key at rawg.io/apidocs, then paste it here. Without a key: no covers are shown.
settings.rawgKeyHelp: Leave empty to keep the current one. It is never shown again.
settings.rawgTestHelp: The test uses the key already saved: save it first.
settings.rawgState.unreachable: RAWG cannot be reached from this server
settings.rawgUnchanged: Nothing to save: the current key is kept.
settings.rawgInvalid: This key does not look right (letters, digits, dashes, at least 8 characters).
settings.rawgTestUnreachable: RAWG cannot be reached from this server.
instances.followThemeHelp: The color adapts when you change the theme in Settings.
home.sizeHelp: The home page is fluid: blocks flow onto the next line depending on space, and stack on a small screen. “Alone on its row” puts a block on its own, centered. The size only says how much room a block likes to take; the default is the feature's recommendation.
home.isolatedHelp: Alone on its own line, centered, with a line break before and after; the following pieces then flow on normally.
updates.unreachable: The repository could not be reached.
updates.confirm: Before updating: the database is backed up, then the new (already compiled) version is downloaded, verified and installed; if anything fails, the previous version is restored automatically. The site is unavailable for a moment while it restarts.
updates.started: Update to {version} started. This page refreshes by itself.
updates.majorWarning: Major version: it may change how the site works. Read its release notes before installing; it is never installed automatically.
updates.chainNote: If your version is old, the intermediate versions it needs are installed first, one by one, automatically.
updates.rolledBack: The previous version was restored: your site works as before.
updates.restartNeeded: The server must be restarted for the change to take effect (no restart command is configured).
updates.autoHelp: Off by default. When on, the site checks every 6 hours and installs fixes and new features by itself (never a major change), with a backup and automatic rollback on failure.
updates.mode.docker: This site runs in a container: update it by replacing the image (rebuild and restart the container), not from the admin.
updates.mode.manual: This site wasn't installed from a release archive: updating from the admin isn't available. See the installation docs.
updates.restart.command: After installation, the server is restarted by the command you configured.
updates.restart.supervised: After installation, the server stops and its supervisor (systemd, pm2, Docker…) restarts it.
updates.restart.manual: No restart command is configured: after installation, restart the server by hand.
updates.error.not-newer: That version is not newer than the installed one.
updates.error.unsupported: This installation cannot update from the admin.
catalogue.intro: Modules verified for this framework: shipped with it, or published in recognized repositories. You can also install a personal, unverified repository.
catalogue.examples: Examples (to learn how to build a module)
catalogue.customWarning: A module is code that runs on your server with the same rights as the site. A personal repository is verified by nobody: only install code whose author you know, and read it. It is installed disabled; you enable it afterwards.
catalogue.trust: I understand this code is not verified and will run on my server.
catalogue.trustRequired: Tick the box to confirm you understand the risk.
modules.error.idmismatch: This repository does not provide the announced module.
modules.error.incompatible: This module is not compatible with this framework version.
modules.error.core: This module needs a newer version of Curiosa. Update the site first (Admin → Updates).
modules.core.needs: This module needs Curiosa {version} or later. Update the site first (Admin → Updates).
backup.intro: Your content, settings, users, feature data and images in a single password-protected file. Make one before an update or a big change, and keep it somewhere other than the site.
backup.createHelp: Choose a password: it protects the file and is stored nowhere.
backup.passwordWarning: At least {n} characters. Without this password the backup cannot be recovered: there is no way to retrieve it. Write it down elsewhere.
backup.readWithout: How to read a backup without Curiosa?
backup.readWithoutHelp: With OpenSSL then tar (on Linux and macOS, installable on Windows). The resulting folder has a README.txt explaining the rest and a "readable" folder with your data as Markdown, JSON and CSV:
backup.restoreHelp: Careful: restoring REPLACES everything currently on the site with the backup's content. You will first see what it contains. Features are reinstalled from the catalogue; a personal feature is only reinstalled if you confirm it, one by one.
backup.done: Restore complete. Sign in again with an account from the backup.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring REPLACES the site's current data with the backup's. A copy of the current database is kept in data/backups/.
backup.confirmReplace: Replace all current data with the backup's?
backup.trustCustom: Reinstall this unverified personal module from:
backup.status.catalogue: will be reinstalled from the catalog
backup.status.unavailable: not found (its data is kept, but the module must be reinstalled by hand)
backup.error.not-a-backup: This file is not a backup of this framework.
backup.error.corrupt: The file is corrupted or incomplete.
backup.error.tampered: The backup was modified or is incomplete: refused.
backup.error.newer-schema: This backup comes from a newer database version: update the framework first.
backup.error.newer-format: This backup comes from a newer framework version: update it first.
backup.error.no-owner: This backup has no owner: refused so you are not locked out.
backup.error.expired: The preview expired (30 minutes): start again.
backup.error.failed: The restore failed; nothing was changed.
setup.restore.link: I already have a backup: restore it instead of creating a new site
setup.restore.title: Restore a backup
setup.restore.help: Get your site back as it was: content, settings, users, modules (reinstalled from the catalog) and images. Choose your backup file and the password you picked when creating it.
backup.error.already-configured: This site is already configured: sign in to the admin to restore.
catalogue.source.repository: Recognized modules list is up to date (read on {date} from the framework repository).
catalogue.source.cache: Framework repository unreachable: last list received on {date}.
catalogue.source.snapshot: List shipped with this framework version (the repository could not be reached or is not configured).
modules.updateAvailableTo: An update of {module} is available: {version}. Your data and settings are kept.
modules.updateMajor: Major change: the module may work differently. Read its release notes before installing. If the new version is invalid, the previous one is restored automatically.
modules.error.uptodate: This module is already up to date.
modules.error.pinned: This module is pinned to a specific commit: it does not update.
migration.failed: Updating this instance's data failed: it was put back to its previous state and set aside (it does not run on half-converted data). A copy of the database is in data/backups/. Fix or update the module, then retry.
migration.newer: This instance's data is newer than the installed module's code (backup restored into an older module?). Update the module, then retry.
modules.error.migration: Module updated, but the data migration of at least one instance failed: it was put back to its previous state and set aside. Open it to retry.
tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
settings.blockAiBotsHelp: robots.txt disallows AI scraping bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot…). No search engine is blocked.
audit.intro: Who did what, and when: sign-ins, settings, features, backups. The content of messages is never recorded.
audit.empty: As soon as something is done in the admin area (sign-in, setting, backup…), it will show up here.
modules.error.requires: This module needs: {services}. No active module offers it, and none ships with the framework: install one (catalog) and try again.
modules.error.requiredBy: Not possible: these active modules depend on it ({modules}). Disable them first.
services.title: Services offered by several modules
services.intro: Several modules offer the same service. The master receives the calls and answers; replicas also receive what is written (from now on: data already received is not copied).
services.pending: To be chosen: until then, the first provider is the master, with no replica.
services.notice: This module offers a service that other modules already offer: choose which one is the master.
services.hint: Drag the arrow from the service dot to a provider (or click one).
catalogue.previewFailed: Could not read this repository (address refused, private repository or unreachable). Nothing was installed.
instances.displayNameHelp: The name you and your visitors will see for this feature.
catalogue.intro.simple: Ready-made features for your site: an address book, game suggestions, Discord announcements… Pick one, read its presentation, and install it in one click.
perm.slots: Adds elements (banners, links…) to your site's pages
perm.routes: Receives what your visitors send (forms, votes…)
perm.filters: Changes how your texts are displayed
perm.sections: Offers blocks you can place on your home page
perm.pages: Adds a page to your site
perm.topics: Exchanges information with your other features
perm.overlay: Provides a screen for your streaming software (OBS)
perm.mcp: Can be driven by your AI assistant
perm.admin: Adds a management area to this dashboard
catalogue.asks.friendly: What this feature will do on your site
catalogue.installNote: It will be installed switched off: you'll switch it on afterwards from “Features”.
dashboard.helloIntro: This is the dashboard of “{site}”. Nothing here can break your site: try things out, you can always go back.
settings.intro.simple: The essentials of your site: its name, logo and colors.
settings.moreLanguages: Offer the site in other languages
instances.deleteWarning.simple: This removes the feature from your site, along with what it contains. There is no undo.
home.intro.simple: Build your home page like a set of bricks: add blocks, put them in order with the arrows, choose their size.
home.empty: Your home page is empty for now. Add a first block!
home.pick: What do you want to show?
setup.welcome.title: Welcome 👋
setup.welcome.text: I'll help you set up your site in a few minutes. First, let's get to know each other.
setup.welcome.name: What's your name?
setup.welcome.nameHelp: Your first name is enough: that's how your dashboard will talk to you.
setup.account.help: Your email and password will let you sign back in to your dashboard.
dashboard.welcome: Your site is live, {name}! Here's where to start: write a first post, pick your colors, or go and see the result.
updates.rcWarning: ⚠️ This version is a release candidate: it hasn't finished being tested and may contain defects. At your own risk — take a real backup first (Backup page).
updates.channelHelp: By default the site only offers stable versions. Release candidates are upcoming versions published ahead of release so they can be tested. Going back to the stable channel doesn't downgrade you: you stay on your version until a newer stable one is out.
updates.channelRisk: I understand this is at my own risk
updates.channelRiskHelp: A release candidate is never installed automatically, even when automatic updates are on.
settings.glowHelp: Large soft colour spots taken from your accent colour, behind the content. Best on a dark background.
settings.glow.tuningHelp: Used when "Custom" is chosen above. Out-of-range values are brought back to the nearest limit.
settings.glow.sizeHelp: 30 to 120. A large spot blends into the background.
settings.glow.varianceHelp: 0: all alike. 100: from very small to very large.
settings.glow.hueHelp: 0: all in the accent colour. 180: each spot may take any hue around the accent (±°).
settings.glow.intensityHelp: Maximum opacity of a spot's core, 5 to 50.
settings.glow.seedHelp: 1 to 9999. Changes the random positions, sizes and hues; the same value always gives the same layout.
settings.bgHelp: A backdrop behind the content, built from your colours. It adds to the glow above.
settings.bgCustomHelp: Used when "Custom" is chosen. A list of layers (gradient, spots, dots, grid, image), 6 at most: see docs/BACKGROUND.md. Nothing is saved if the description is invalid.
navigation.empty: Your menu is empty for now. Add a page of your site or a link.
navigation.pickPage: Which page do you want in the menu?
navigation.noMorePages: All your pages are already in the menu.
settings.glow.colorHelp: Used when the box above is unchecked. The "hue shift" applies starting from this colour.
settings.bgSvgHelp: Paste the code of an SVG drawing (exported from Inkscape, Figma, Illustrator…): gradients, dot patterns, silhouettes, motifs. It needs a viewBox. Colours can follow the theme: write {accent}, {bg}, {fg}… instead of a colour code. No scripts, text or embedded images: see docs/BACKGROUND.md.
settings.bgSvgAlignHelp: When the window doesn't have the drawing's proportions, the drawing is cropped: choose which side stays visible.
settings.faviconHelp: A square image (png, jpg, webp or gif; 64 × 64 px or larger). Without an image, the site builds an icon from its colours.
instances.sortHelp: Newest first by default. A "featured" entry always comes first.
sort.title: By title (A → Z)
settings.statsHelp: Daily counters shown on the dashboard: no IP address, cookie or identifier is ever kept. Visitors who refuse tracking (Do Not Track) are not counted.
dashboard.visitsPrivacy: Anonymous counting: no personal data is kept.
redirects.examples: Examples: /twitch → your channel, /shop → your online shop, /donate → your support page.
settings.logosHelp: Upload what you have: nothing is required, the site does its best with the images it receives.
settings.logoWideHelp: Symbol and name side by side. Shown at the top of the site instead of the written name.
settings.logoSquareHelp: The symbol alone. Used small (phone, badges) and in place of the horizontal logo when it is missing.
settings.logoShareHelp: Shown when the site is shared (social networks, messengers). Ideal: 1200 × 630 px. Without one, the site uses your icon.
settings.logosDarkHelp: If your site has a dark background and your logo is dark, upload a light version here. The site picks the right one from the background color.
navigation.groupEmpty: This menu is empty: add pages or links to it (an empty menu is not saved).
settings.headerHelp: Choose the layout of the top of your pages. The logo, menu, languages and the elements below place themselves.
settings.header.classicHelp: Logo on the left, menu on the right.
settings.header.twoRowsHelp: Logo and button on top, menu below.
settings.header.centeredHelp: Logo in the middle, menu centered below.
settings.header.minimalHelp: Logo and a "Menu" button: discreet, on large screens too.
settings.header.socials: Show my social networks in the header
settings.header.socialsHelp: Active networks: {count}. Each network is a module: add or remove them from Modules.
settings.header.socialsNone: No social network yet. Each network (Twitch, YouTube…) is a module: add one from Modules and its icon appears here by itself.
settings.header.label: Text
settings.header.linksHelp: A link or button only appears when both its text and address are filled. The address is a site page (/contact), an https://… link or mailto:…
settings.privacyHelp: What the site measures, what it leaves to robots, and its privacy page. Unless a visitor turns on the “news” button, no tracking cookie is set (only the chosen-language one).
site.newsHelp: Remembers the date of your last visit in your browser to flag what is new. A second click erases everything.
settings.newsToggle: Let visitors choose to be notified of news
settings.newsToggleHelp: Adds a "Notify me of news" button to the header. The menu's news dots only appear for visitors who turned it on: nothing is stored for the others, so no cookie banner is needed.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes what the site "{name}" records about you. It is generated automatically from how the site really works.
privacy.whoContact: The site "{name}" is run by its owner. For any question about your data, write to {email}.
privacy.whoNoContact: The site "{name}" is run by its owner. For any question about your data, use the contact details given on the site.
privacy.cookies: Cookies and storage in your browser
privacy.cookies.locale: **Language**: the site remembers the language you choose (cookie "curiosa_locale", 1 year). It is needed to show you the site in the right language.
privacy.cookies.news: **News**: only if you turn on the "Notify me of news" button yourself, the site remembers in your browser the date of your last visit to flag what is new (cookies "curiosa_news", "curiosa_seen" and "curiosa_since", up to 1 year). A second click on the button erases everything.
privacy.cookies.none: The site sets no advertising or tracking cookie and uses no third-party measurement service.
privacy.stats.on: The site counts its visits anonymously: page views, most read pages and where visitors come from, as daily counters. Nothing is stored in your browser and your IP address is never recorded; to count a visitor only once a day, the server derives a single-use fingerprint from it, deleted the next day, which cannot recognise you from one day to the next. Visitors who send "Do Not Track" or "Global Privacy Control" are not counted.
privacy.stats.off: The site does not count its visits.
privacy.features: Data collected by the site's features
privacy.rights.text: You can ask for access to the data about you, for its correction or erasure, object to its processing, or lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.
settings.privacyPageHelp: The mandatory text (cookies, statistics, data of your features, visitors' rights) is generated from what the site really does: it shows at the bottom of every page and cannot be removed. You can only add your own information to it.
settings.privacyExtraHelp: Simple Markdown. Shown after the mandatory text: data controller, retention period, how to exercise rights…
home.core.media.help: A title, a paragraph, a button, with one or more images beside it.
home.core.tabs.help: A list of tabs: visitors click a name to read its text (benefits, plans, steps…).
home.core.stats.help: A few big numbers with a caption (members, events, years…).
home.core.cta.help: A title, a sentence and a prominent button to invite people to sign up, write or discover.
home.core.video.help: A big title set over a video playing in the background (uploaded to your site).
block.kindHelp.media: Text on one side, images on the other. Perfect to present your activity or a novelty. Everything is optional: fill in only what you want to show.
block.kindHelp.tabs: Tabs: each has a name, a heading and a text. Visitors click to switch. Add one tab per benefit, plan or step.
block.kindHelp.stats: Figures to highlight: write the number ("12,000+") and its caption ("members"). Add as many as you like.
block.kindHelp.cta: A short message with a button, to prompt an action: sign up, write to you, discover a page.
block.kindHelp.video: Your text appears over a video playing in the background, only while it is on screen. Upload a short, light video (MP4 or WebM).
block.title: Title
block.imagesHelp: Up to three images, side by side with a slight offset.
block.imagesTabsHelp: Up to three images shared by all tabs; a tab can have its own image, which replaces them.
block.videoHelp: MP4 or WebM, 50 MB at most. Prefer a short, light video that loops.
block.sound: Let visitors turn the sound on
block.soundHelp: The video always starts muted (browsers require it); a button lets visitors unmute it.
block.bgHelp: Placed behind the content. Tip: an image sized like the block, prepared with your own elements, lets you put a visual exactly where you want.
modules.error.nosubdir: Module folder not found in the repository, or no valid module.json in it.
catalogue.sources.intro: A developer (you or someone else) publishes their modules in a single git repository, one folder per module. Add that repository here: its modules show up below and are installed one by one. Nobody verifies them, and they update from that same repository.
catalogue.sources.removeConfirm: Remove this repository from the list? Modules already installed stay installed.
catalogue.sources.none: No module found in this repository.
modules.error.sourceSubdir: Give the repository address without a folder: its modules are found automatically.
modules.error.sourceMax: Too many repositories: remove one before adding another.
modules.error.sourceEmpty: No module (module.json file) found in this repository.
setup.modules.title: Would you like to add modules, {name}?
setup.modules.help: A module adds a feature to your site (a blog, your social networks, pages…). Here are the ones we suggest to get started.
setup.modules.skip: You can skip this step without any risk: nothing is required, and every module (these and many more) can be added or removed later from the admin, under Features → Add.
setup.modules.none: No module to suggest for now: you can add some from the admin whenever you like.
login.locked: Too many attempts. You can try again at {time}.
account.sessionsHelp: You are signed in on this device, and maybe on others. If you lost a phone or lent your computer, you can sign out every device at once, this one included.
account.sessionsConfirm: Sign out all your devices, including this one?
users.revokeConfirm: Sign this person out of all their devices? They can sign back in with their password.
login.changed: Password changed: sign in again with the new one.
login.codeHelp: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code shown. No phone? Enter one of your backup codes.
account.twofa.title: Two-step verification
account.twofa.help: After your password, you are asked for a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds, shown by an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…). Even if someone found your password, they could not get in.
account.twofa.scan: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account by scanning this code, or by typing the key below.
account.twofa.confirm: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app to confirm
account.twofa.codesHelp: Write them down or print them, and keep them somewhere safe (password manager, paper). If you lose your phone, each one lets you in once. They will never be shown again.
account.twofa.codesDone: Got it, I kept my codes
account.twofa.disableHelp: To turn off, confirm with your password and a code from the app (or a backup code). You will be signed out.
account.twofa.regenHelp: New codes replace all the old ones. Confirm with your password.
account.twofa.required: The site owner requires two-step verification: you cannot turn it off.
account.twofa.need: The site owner requires two-step verification for the whole team: turn it on to continue.
users.twofaReset: Reset their two-step verification and passkeys
users.twofaResetConfirm: Remove this person's two-step verification and passkeys (they also lose their open sessions)? They can set them up again from My account.
users.require2fa: Require two-step verification for the whole team
users.require2faHelp: Everyone will have to turn it on at their next visit. You must have turned it on yourself first.
users.require2faNeedsYou: First turn on two-step verification on your own account (My account).
account.passkeys.title: Passkeys
account.passkeys.help: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face or code (or a security key), with no password or code. It is the safest method: a fake site cannot steal it. Register one per device.
account.passkeys.name: Name (e.g. My phone)
account.passkeys.removeHelp: Remove this passkey? Confirm with your password.
account.passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
account.passkeys.failed: The passkey could not be registered.
account.passkeys.max: You reached the maximum number of passkeys (10).
instances.linkHelp: A page of the site (for example /contact), an https://… address or a mailto:… address
instances.error.link: The link "{field}" is not valid: enter a page of the site (/contact), an https://… address or mailto:…
instances.error.groupRequired: To save "{group}", fill in: {fields} (or remove it).
settings.identityIntro: Who is behind the site, and how people recognise it.
settings.taglineHelp: A short sentence that sums up the site.
settings.contactEmailHelp: Used as the contact address on the privacy page and for the site's messages.
settings.enabledLocalesHelp: Tick the ones visitors can choose; the main language is always offered.
redirects.permanentHelp: Leave unticked if the destination may change one day.
social.noneHelp: Pick one from the list below: its button will appear in the site header.
social.addHelp: One click is enough; you will then enter your profile address.
home.noFeatures: The features you install (blog, calendar…) will also be available here.
entries.emptyHelp: Write your first entry: it stays a draft, invisible on the site, until you publish it.
entries.sharedHint: The image, link, code and dates are the same for every language.
entries.status.draftHelp: Only visible here. Nothing appears on the site: take your time.
entries.status.publishedHelp: Visible to everyone on the site.
entries.summaryHelp: One or two sentences shown on cards and in previews. Empty = the beginning of the content.
entries.expiresHelp: Leave empty if it never ends. After this date the entry disappears from the site by itself.
entries.newIntro: Start with the title. The entry is saved as a draft until you choose “Published”.
entries.created: Entry created. You can keep editing it here.
entries.dangerHelp: Deleting is permanent. To simply take it off the site, choose “Draft” above instead.
entries.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
entries.deleteVersionConfirm: Delete this language version? The other languages are untouched. This cannot be undone.
sources.allUsed: Every source is used, including ones you add later.
sources.onlyChecked: Only the checked sources are used.
updates.modules.title: Your modules
updates.modules.help: Modules are installed and updated separately from the site. Those with a new version appear here.
updates.modules.behind: {n} behind their latest version. Your data and settings are kept.
updates.modules.upToDate: All your modules are up to date.
updates.modules.none: No module to check for now.
updates.modules.confirmAll: Update all {n} modules, one after the other? Your data and settings are kept.
updates.modules.confirmMajor: {name} changes a lot in this version: how it works may change. Update it anyway?
updates.modules.majorWarning: At least one module changes a lot in this version: how it works may change. If the new version does not suit you, the old one is restored.
updates.modules.incomplete: Not everything could be updated: see the details below.
updates.modules.stoppedLine: We stopped at {name} to avoid breaking anything. Open that module, fix it, then try again.
updates.modules.incompatLine: Waiting for a site update (they need a newer version of Curiosa): {names}
modules.searchEmptyHint: Try another word, or clear the search to see all your modules again.
placement.title: Where to find it
placement.helpDefault: Chosen automatically, depending on what this feature does. Change it if you would rather find it elsewhere.
placement.helpChosen: This is your choice: it replaces the automatic placement.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: What you set up once, then leave running: social networks, channels, overlays, announcements… Turn each one on or off, or adjust it, from here.
integrations.emptyTitle: Nothing is put away here yet
integrations.emptyHelp: Features you set up once (social networks, overlays, announcements…) will show up here as soon as you add some.
integrations.errorHint: A problem was reported: open the settings to see which one.
hub.tab.updates.title: Module updates
hub.coreLink: To update the site itself, open the site's Updates page.
updates.modulesLink.behind: {n} of your modules have a new version.
updates.modulesLink.ok: Your modules are up to date.
overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.intro: The screens you add to your streaming software (OBS): alerts, tickers, games… Copy the address of each one and paste it into an OBS “Browser” source.
overlays.emptyHelp: Screens for OBS (alerts, scrolling tickers, maze…) will show up here as soon as you add some.
overlays.obsHelp: In OBS: add a “Browser” source and paste this address.
overlays.obsOff: This overlay is turned off: the address will only work once it is turned on.
settings.colorOptionalHint: Optional: leave empty for an automatic value.
settings.contrast.text: Text is hard to read on this background (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 recommended).
settings.contrast.accent: The accent barely stands out from the background (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 3:1 recommended).
settings.contrast.accent2: The secondary color barely stands out from the background (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 3:1 recommended).
